title: 2008 Munster Senior Hurling Championship
text:
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} The '''[[Munster Senior Hurling Championship|2008 Munster Senior Hurling Championship]]''' was an annual [[hurling]] competition played between 1 June and 13 July 2008 between five hurling counties from the province of [[Munster]]. The [[2008 Munster Senior Hurling Championship Final|Munster final]] was played on 13 July 2008 in the [[Gaelic Grounds]], [[Limerick]], between [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] and [[Clare GAA|Clare]]. Tipperary claimed their first [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship|Munster Senior Hurling]] title since 2001 and 37th title overall as they overcame Clare by a score of 2–21 to 0–19. ==Teams== *[[Clare GAA]] *[[Cork GAA|Cork]] *[[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] *[[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] *[[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] ==Results== {{football box | date = June 1
